ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white regions occupy the central and distal areas of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border on the trailing edge, a triangular cluster at the peduncle junction, and a distinct circular patch on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth serrations across the entire trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes between 5 and 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes terminating in tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: One prominent high-contrast dark circular ring located in the medial region of the left lobe; smaller dark clusters located near the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Cluster of 5-6 parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the distal end of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant rake marks on the right lobe apex and a circular scar on the left lobe.
